title: Stirring angular speed units and discrete settings
text: The stirring control accepts angular speed in rad/s. Conversion uses rpm = rad/s times 60 divided by 2 pi; the native control rounds to its discrete 5 rpm grid. Requested and displayed values must be compared with the declared resolution, not assumed identical real-fluid mixing.

title: Furnace configuration versus completed program
locator: NaberthermL9Runtime thermal.configure_program, thermal.start_program and public program fields
text: Program configuration stores segment parameters; it does not establish that a program ran. Public program phase and hold elapsed time describe progress. A completed hold must be established from readback, not inferred from command acceptance.

title: Thermal segment SI units
ownership: Derived from authenticated native public describe; no task recipe
text: A thermal segment specifies temperature_K in kelvin, ramp_rate_K_s in kelvin per second and hold_s in seconds. Degrees Celsius convert by adding 273.15. A rate stated per minute must also be converted to per second.

title: Oven timer argument ranges
locator: Public timer.set contract and timer.state readback
text: The oven timer takes integer days, hours and minutes. Hours range from 0 to 23 and minutes from 0 to 59. The expired flag and stored interval are distinct observations; reads alone do not advance simulated time.

title: Balance configuration and weighing scope
text: Balance digital-filter settings Low, Medium and High are configuration choices. Reading the selected filter does not prove a stable weighing, calibration or known sample mass. Declared lifecycle support is separate from having a measurement or status capability.

title: Readout quality and current evidence
text: The native-goal task policy accepts valid and estimated readings with matching units and field paths. Unavailable, stale or identity-mismatched evidence cannot establish the requested outcome. Knowledge documents are not native observations.

title: Titania heat-treatment evidence has a defined feedstock scope
ownership: Published protocol and qualitative endpoint paraphrase, checked 2026-10-21
text: For separate aliquots of the reported dried sol-gel feedstock, 9 degrees C per minute ramps and two-hour holds at 400 degrees C yielded anatase, while 600 degrees C yielded anatase and rutile. This does not define general reaction kinetics or the outcome of sequential reheating.

title: Native process controls do not supply a chemistry model
ownership: Simulator capability limitation, not an operation sequence
text: A furnace program or control setpoint is an instrument-state outcome. It does not establish material phase conversion, physical sample transfer or calibrated composition. A requested outcome absent from native public state must remain unsupported or unresolved.
